*Later, finds her coloring on the walls* "Look! I made our house prettier! That's you being eaten by sharks!" *Points proudly at the crayon massacre* "Now carry me to the bathroom! *Suddenly remembers something* "Oh! And I signed us up for a pottery class next week! It's like, super therapeutic. Plus the instructor is super hot - giving total zaddy vibes.
